name: MonarchWidget
title: Widget
wrapsNative: MonarchCard (or a plain VStack) with a header of Text, Button and Menu with .menuStyle(.button); MonarchEmptyState, MonarchInlineErrorRetry and MonarchInlineNotice for the states; TimelineView(.everyMinute) for the updated line
summary: The frame of a dashboard widget: a title with a period, header actions, an overflow menu, View all, and its own loading, empty and error states.
whenToUse: On a home or dashboard screen made of independent sections that load on their own, or when a section needs a period label, View all or an overflow menu (refresh, export, remove).
whenNotToUse: For a single figure inside another surface, use MonarchMetric. For a container with no data states, use MonarchCard. For a titled section without a box, use MonarchSectionHeader.
api: init(_ title: String, description: String? = nil, period: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, variant: MonarchWidgetVariant = .card, state: MonarchWidgetState = .ready, isRetrying: Bool = false, updatedAt: Date? = nil, footer: String? = nil, labels: MonarchWidgetLabels = MonarchWidgetLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onViewAll: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions, @ViewBuilder menu: () -> MenuItems, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content)
init(… the same …, @ViewBuilder menu: () -> MenuItems, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) where Actions == EmptyView
init(… the same …, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) where Actions == EmptyView, MenuItems == EmptyView
enum MonarchWidgetState { case ready, loading, empty(String? = nil), failed(String? = nil) }
struct MonarchWidgetLabels { var menu, viewAllLabel, loading, updated: (@Sendable (String) -> String)?; var viewAll, error, empty: String? }

options.name: title
options.description: The widget's title. It has the header trait.

options.name: description
options.description: A caption line under the title.

options.name: period
options.description: The period the figures cover, muted beside the title.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: A decorative SF Symbol before the title.

options.name: variant
options.description: card draws a MonarchCard without a shadow; plain has no surface, for a widget inside another surface.

options.name: state
options.description: ready shows the content; loading three placeholder lines; empty a small MonarchEmptyState; failed the message, with Try again when onRetry is set.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: With failed and onRetry: the Try again button is busy.

options.name: updatedAt
options.description: Shown in the footer as "Updated 5 minutes ago", refreshed every minute. Hidden while loading.

options.name: footer
options.description: A note under the body. Hidden while loading.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Try again to the failed state.

options.name: onViewAll
options.description: Adds a View all button to the header; the app navigates.

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls in the header before the menu, such as a small segmented Picker.

options.name: menu
options.description: The overflow menu's items: Button, Toggle, Divider. A destructive item takes role: .destructive.

options.name: content
options.description: The body, shown in the ready state.

states.name: ready
states.description: The content is shown under the header.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three static placeholder lines in the muted background colour, one element read as "Loading" and the title. The footer is hidden.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState with the given title or "Nothing to show yet".

states.name: failed
states.description: A MonarchInlineErrorRetry with Try again when onRetry is set, otherwise a plain danger MonarchInlineNotice. The failure is announced.

appearance: The card variant is a MonarchCard without a shadow: the surface background and the subtle border role. The title is label-size semibold text in the default text role; the period, description and footer use the muted text role. Header buttons are small ghost MonarchButtons. The placeholder lines use the muted background role. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes come from these roles.
platformNotes: The web Widget is a <section> landmark with a heading level, a link for View all and an items array for the menu. On iOS the title has the header trait (there are no landmarks or heading levels), View all is a button whose action the app uses to navigate, and the menu takes standard Menu items through a view builder. The web `span` belongs to its DashboardGrid and has no equivalent here. The web loading placeholder can be replaced with `skeleton`; on iOS pass state .ready with content redacted by .redacted(reason: .placeholder) instead. The web's Try again can wait on a promise; on iOS the app sets isRetrying. Android uses the same name and options. Several closures are optional (onRetry, onViewAll). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRetry.
accessibility: The title has the header trait, so the Headings rotor moves between widgets; the icon is hidden.
The menu button is icon-only and named "More actions for" and the title; View all is named "View all:" and the title, starting with its visible text.
The loading placeholder is one element named "Loading" and the title.
A change to the failed state is announced with the message; Try again is a separate button from MonarchInlineErrorRetry.
At the accessibility text sizes the header controls move under the title instead of squeezing it.
Header buttons keep 44-point touch targets through MonarchButtonStyle.
edgeCases: Long titles wrap; the header controls keep their size.
The updated line is relative to the current time and refreshes every minute.
The ready state with no content shows only the header.
